versions.name: RXV2-0.9.829-untitled
versions.notes: A new board is called Untitled and its front page asks - rather than forces - you to rename it as soon as you can, with the menu working underneath. Two boards with the same name cannot be told apart, and the banner says so.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.828-list-follows-rename
versions.notes: iOS app: a board already in the model list takes the new name it advertises after a rename, instead of sitting there under the old one

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.827-rename-follows
versions.notes: iOS app: the link's own idea of the board's name follows a rename, so after renaming a freshly wiped chip the app no longer sits reconnecting to the name it knew before

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.826-update-record-truth
versions.notes: The update record never calls a good install a failure: it reads the target from a release-named file as well as a version folder, judges an unknown target by whether the version changed, and the fleet watcher now names what it installs

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.825-dongle-event-log
versions.notes: A dongle or simulator interface now has an Event log button on its front page: the Black box page is hidden on those, and the Event log - with Send debug data to Malcolm - lived only behind it, so a dongle could not report a fault at all

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.824-new-name-first-paint
versions.notes: After a rename the front page paints the NEW name from its first frame: the last-known-name memory it paints from is taught the new name the moment the receiver accepts it

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.823-no-old-name-flash
versions.notes: iOS app: after a rename the front page shows the new name from the first moment, instead of iOS's cached old one for two seconds

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.822-remember-new-name
versions.notes: iOS app: after a rename the app remembers the NEW name, so the model list auto-connects to the board under its new name instead of hunting for the old one

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.821-dongle-naming-gate
versions.notes: The first-run naming box works on a dongle: it deleted three elements it then wrote to, the script died before attaching Save, and the form fell back to a page reload - the box came straight back with no error. Never seen before because every dongle had its name baked in by the flashing script.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.820-no-stall-naming
versions.notes: Dongle on the bench: the automatic-role re-listen no longer freezes the board for 2.6 s every 15 s; the first-run name save over Bluetooth waits for the board's answer instead of firing and leaving; and the naming box now has a way out to the event log

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.819-column-apps
versions.notes: Ships the centred column to both apps (0.9.818 committed it but --fw-only skipped the app builds)

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.818-centred-column
versions.notes: Both apps: a centred column instead of full width, so an iPad or tablet no longer stretches the buttons across the whole screen

rotorflight.line: Rotorflight 2.3 — the release these pages are written and tested against.
